p1: [whispers] At 2 a.m., my doorbell camera showed my mum. [pause] She lives four hours away.
[low, quiet] Every Sunday she calls me, and always hangs up the same way.
[whispers, uneasy] She was in her dressing gown. Smiling. [whispers] Not blinking.
[whispers, sweetly] It's me, love. Let me in.
[low, nervous] My hand was on the lock when my phone buzzed.
[softly, sleepy] Can't sleep, love. Talk on Sunday?
[whispers, shaky] I said... you're not my mum.
[whispers, menacing] If you won't open the door for her... let's see if she'll open it for you.
[whispers, scared] Then it walked off. Toward the highway.
[quietly, voice breaking] That was four hours ago.
[whispers, unsettling] Someone's at my door, love. It sounds just like you.
[whispers] I'm driving there now. Follow for what I find.
